purpose: External Validity, Multi-Center Dermoscopy Replication, and Clinical Actionability Battery

inclusion_exclusion_rules.SCC_handling: Excluded from 7-class metrics (431 dropped); scored as Tier 1 in 3-tier clinical actionability
inclusion_exclusion_rules.missing_age: Excluded from age-band stratified slices; reported as separate unknown row
inclusion_exclusion_rules.lesion_grouping: Grouped by lesion_id where available; single images treated as singleton clusters where null
inclusion_exclusion_rules.split_discipline: BCN+MSK 70/15/15 lesion-grouped split (split_bcnmsk.csv); test split read once

E0_comparison_arm.status: WITHDRAWN before any result was computed
E0_comparison_arm.reason: the arm required retraining under a re-weighted age prior; the checkpoints are frozen (see the immutability rule) and the two scripts that would have produced it were never implemented beyond a stub. Withdrawing it is a smaller claim than reporting it, not a larger one.
E0_comparison_arm.multiple_comparison_handling: retained in the family denominator and entered into Holm-Bonferroni at p = 1.0. The family stays at 5 members; withdrawing a member by shrinking the denominator would inflate every survivor.

E6_decision_curves.status: POST-HOC SECONDARY -- added after the v1 lock
E6_decision_curves.honest_note: E6 does not appear in v1's endpoint list. It was written into the battery after the SHA-256 freeze and is therefore not pre-registered. It is reported as exploratory, is excluded from the Holm family, and carries no confirmatory claim.
E6_decision_curves.test_anchor: net benefit on HAM test reconstructed from TP, FP and N in results/session9/agerule_test.csv -- a frozen S9 artifact. No new test read.

E7_case_atlas.status: POST-HOC SECONDARY -- added after the v1 lock; illustrative only
E7_case_atlas.honest_note: a figure, not an endpoint. No statistic is drawn from it and it enters no family. Exemplars are selected by running the frozen rule, and a panel with no qualifying case is shown as empty.

frozen_transfer_parameters.dirichlet_map_note: v1 named research/calibration/results_oof/fit_state.json. That is a different map (max |dW| = 0.18). The file named here is bit-identical to the calibrator run_session5_agerule fits in process and the one research/session9/testpass.py scores the age rule with, so it is the map under which the frozen lambdas and the S9 test anchor mean what they say. Asserted by research.external.frozen_params --selftest.
frozen_transfer_parameters.conformal_map: research/conformal/results_oof/fit_state.json -- the conformal quantiles were calibrated under their own tuning-half Dirichlet map and must be applied under it, not under the deployed map.
frozen_transfer_parameters.mahalanobis_centroids: fitted on HAM train features, zero target fitting
frozen_transfer_parameters.loader: research/external/frozen_params.py (single entry point; nothing is typed)

multiple_comparison_family.denominator_note: held at 5 members. E0 is withdrawn and enters at p = 1.0 rather than being removed; E6 and E7 are post-hoc and enter no family.

E1_dose_response_skew_ordering.rationale: the under-40 escalating prior is 4.85% in HAM, 4.8% in MSKCC and 18.6% in BCN. Ordering under-40 argmax escalation sensitivity by that skew tests the decision-rule account as a dose-response across three independent centres rather than as a binary replication in one.
E1_dose_response_skew_ordering.prediction: if the failure is a decision-rule artefact of a low escalating prior, sensitivity should order BCN > HAM ~ MSKCC; if the escalation-mass AUC is flat across the same ordering, the ranking signal survives and only the operating point moves.
E1_dose_response_skew_ordering.direction: two-sided; a null or reversed ordering is reported as measured
E1_dose_response_skew_ordering.status: declared before any BCN/MSK image was scored (S13 has not run)

deviations.actual: five scripts read research/predictions (plain, 1-view) on the test split outside the single pre-registered S9 pass, which the receipt records as 2 executions covering 19 quantities, none of them E3, E4, E6 or E7
deviations.resolution: every HAM panel repointed to the out-of-fold 24-view TTA matrix (N=6,981); where a table wants a test column it is reconstructed from frozen S9 artifacts

deviations.resolution: L0 is HAM val, as in S8b; the test arm is deleted
deviations.affects_inference: AUROC val-vs-PAD 0.913, separation ratio 18x -- the S8b figures, unchanged. Nothing rested on the test arm.

deviations.actual: APS was reimplemented inline as a deterministic cumulative sum while the stored quantiles were calibrated with the project's randomised APS/RAPS score, so APS marginal coverage read 0.36 against a nominal 0.95
deviations.resolution: research.conformal.scores is imported; the in-distribution reference is the OOF tuning half, scored under the conformal Dirichlet map the quantiles were calibrated with
deviations.affects_inference: APS mondrian a05 in-distribution coverage 0.36 -> 0.947. The tuning half is not fully held out (the Dirichlet map and RAPS hyperparameters were fitted on it); the audit carries the ID-to-shift contrast, not an absolute HAM coverage claim, which S9 owns on test.
